subject: Helix Health POC: sprint wiring + close timeline / MAP items
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@helixhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Helix Health POC: sprint wiring + close timeline / MAP items

Hi Lena / Samir —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a focused sprint plan for POC readiness and the mutual action items we discussed. High-level asks we need to cover in the next two weeks are:

- Org & user setup (tenant invite + admin contact)
- API key provisioning for the trial account
- IP allowlist for staging endpoints (static ranges requested below)
- VPC peering test window and basic routing diagram

I've attached a short MAP draft (Helix_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf) that lays out owners and target dates. Our recommended close timeline is: 11/18 — API keys & org seed; 11/20 — IP allowlist applied and smoke tests; 11/24 — VPC peering validation; 11/30 — evaluation report.

Can you confirm owners for org invites and whether your networking team can provide a 2-hour window for peering validation on 11/22 or 11/23? If those dates don't work, we'll adjust.

Technical note for your network team: we're requesting outbound allowlist to the following egress ranges (Redwood staging): 52.14.120.0/24, 52.14.121.0/24. Please share the Helix staging CIDR you prefer for the routing diagram and we'll draft the peering config.

Ben will follow up with a minimal-run checklist for keys and test tokens. Neha is copied for any infra-level constraints.

Next step: if you can reply with owners + a confirmation of a peering validation window, I'll finalize the MAP and start the DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment(s): Helix_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, vpc-peering-diagram-helix.png
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@helixhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@helixhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Helix Health POC: sprint wiring + close timeline / MAP items

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick items from our side:

1) Owners: I'll own the org invite + admin contact (I'll send admin name and email by EOD). Samir will loop in networking for IP/CIDR details.
2) Peering window: 11/23 13:00–15:00 PT works best for us — Samir confirms availability.
3) IP ranges: our staging CIDR for the peering is 10.12.8.0/22. We'll also need the detailed peering diagram (thanks for attaching).

Can Ben include the minimal verification curl examples in the checklist so our infra team can validate quickly? Also, do you support ephemeral API keys for the trial or do we need a service account?

I'll take a look at the MAP and get back with any edits. If all looks good we'll sign the MAP once the owners and dates are locked.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Integrations | Helix Health
lena.ortiz@helixhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@helixhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Helix Health POC: sprint wiring + close timeline / MAP items

Hi Lena —

Short checklist for your infra team (compact, copy/paste friendly):

1) Org setup
   - Provide admin email for tenant invite (we send SSO invite or local account)
2) API keys
   - We can issue short-lived API keys (default 24h) or a service account key for the trial. For automated test harnessing, a service-account-style key is easier. Choose which you prefer and we'll provision.
3) IP allowlist (for Helix -> Redwood calls)
   - Allowlist these egress ranges: 52.14.120.0/24, 52.14.121.0/24
   - If you need TLS inspection exceptions, please let us know now.
4) VPC peering prep (two-step)
   - Share your VPC ID and the routing CIDR (you mentioned 10.12.8.0/22)
   - We'll create a peering request and provide a sample route table configuration.
5) Smoke tests (post-peering)
   - curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' https://staging.redwoodinference.com/v1/health
   - POST small generation request (example payload included in Drive link)

I'll attach a short peering config snippet to the shared Drive folder and update the MAP doc. If you'd like, we can run the smoke tests in a joint Zoom and share screen during the 11/23 13:00–15:00 PT window.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@helixhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Helix Health POC: sprint wiring + close timeline / MAP items

Lena / Samir —

Perfect, thanks for confirming the 11/23 slot. Updated plan below with agreed owners and firm dates (I'm copying into the MAP doc too):

- 11/16 — MAP draft shared (owner: Jordan Blake) [done]
- 11/18 — Org invited + admin confirmed (owner: Lena Ortiz)
- 11/19 — API key choice confirmed (short-lived vs service account) (owner: Lena)
- 11/22 — Pre-peering checklist review (owner: Ben Carter)
- 11/23 13:00–15:00 PT — VPC peering validation & joint smoke test (owners: Samir + Ben)
- 11/24 — Finalize peering routing adjustments if needed (owner: Samir)
- 11/30 — POC evaluation artifacts due (owner: Jordan)

DocuSign: I'll send the MAP for signature after Lena confirms admin email and the API key preference. Please note: if you choose service-account keys we'll need a short network policy addendum to reflect access controls; Ben will draft that.

Neha: one constraint from infra — if peering requires BGP changes on Helix edge, we should know ahead; otherwise simple static route peering is fine. Can you flag any non-negotiable compliance checks that would impact the 11/23 window?

Lena: quick ack when you have the admin email and API key preference and we'll proceed.

Thanks,
Jordan
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@helixhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@helixhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Helix Health POC: sprint wiring + close timeline / MAP items

Jordan —

Admin email: infra-admin@helixhealth.com (we'll create a role account for the trial).
API keys: we prefer a short-lived key rotation flow (24h) for the trial — Samir will run the automation.
Peering: Samir confirmed no BGP changes — static route peering OK. 11/23 13:00–15:00 PT confirmed.

I've reviewed the MAP and made two small edits (delegation of smoke-test approval to Samir). I'll sign once you send the DocuSign envelope. Thanks for being flexible on timing — looking forward to the joint test.

Best,
Lena

---
Helix Health
Lena Ortiz, Head of Integrations
